# Sig's Kitchen BBQ

Slow-smoked BBQ food truck and catering, run by two brothers based in Fremont, NH with a Saturday home in Methuen, MA. We serve weddings, corporate lunches, graduations, festivals, fundraisers, and backyard parties across Massachusetts and New Hampshire.

## Tagline

"We Rub It, You Love It."

## What we cook

Slow-smoked brisket, pulled pork, pulled chicken, St. Louis ribs, sweet & sticky pork belly, smoke-fried chicken wings (BBQ or Habanero Jerk), three signature smash burgers (Classic, BBQ, Meat-Ur-Match — brisket + pulled pork stack), and sides: smoked mac & cheese, cucumber salad, baked beans, tater tots, potato salad. Custom-flavor sausages in partnership with Borrelli's of Methuen.

## Service area

Massachusetts: Methuen, North Andover, Malden, and surrounding Essex County towns.
New Hampshire: Fremont, Portsmouth, Manchester, Derry, Epping, Newton, Seabrook, and surrounding Rockingham County towns.
